apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#
  namespace: #{namespace}#
  labels:
    app: #{servicesname}#
    version: "#{tag}#"
spec:
  replicas: 2
  revisionHistoryLimit: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 0
      maxSurge: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: #{servicesname}#
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: #{servicesname}#
        version: "#{tag}#"
    spec:
#      nodeSelector:
#        agentpool: agentpool2
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: false
        runAsUser: 0
        runAsGroup: 0
        fsGroup: 0
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
        - name: nginx-cache
          emptyDir:
            sizeLimit: 100Mi
        - name: app-logs
          emptyDir:
            sizeLimit: 50Mi
      containers:
        - name: #{servicesname}#
          image: "#{containerregistries}#/#{servicesname}##{ambiente}#:#{tag}#"
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
              protocol: TCP
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: #{servicesname}#-config
            - secretRef:
                name: #{servicesname}#-secret
          env:
            - name: TZ
              value: "America/Costa_Rica"
            - name: NODE_ENV
              value: "production"
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
            - name: nginx-cache
              mountPath: /var/cache/nginx
            - name: app-logs
              mountPath: /var/log/nginx
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "#{reqcpu}#m"
              memory: "#{reqmem}#Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "#{limcpu}#m"
              memory: "#{limmem}#Mi"
          # Health checks optimizados
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
              scheme: HTTP
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 30
            timeoutSeconds: 3
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
            timeoutSeconds: 2
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 30
            failureThreshold: 3
            timeoutSeconds: 5
          lifecycle:
            preStop:
              exec:
                command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 15"]

apiVersion: v1

  namespace: #{namespace}#
  labels:
    app: #{servicesname}#
spec:

  ports:

---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-ingress
  namespace: #{namespace}#
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/backend-protocol: "HTTP"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-body-size: "300m"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-buffering: "on"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-connect-timeout: "30"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-send-timeout: "240"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout: "240"
    # Keepalive y buffers para reducir latencia portal → usuario
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/upstream-keepalive-connections: "32"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/upstream-keepalive-timeout: "60s"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/upstream-keepalive-requests: "100"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-buffer-size: "16k"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-buffers-number: "8"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/enable-compression: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/compression-level: "6"

    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/affinity: "cookie"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/affinity-mode: "persistent"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/session-cookie-name: "route"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/session-cookie-path: "/"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/session-cookie-max-age: "86400"

    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-next-upstream: "error timeout http_502 http_503 http_504"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-next-upstream-tries: "3"
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  tls:
    - hosts:
        - portal-dev.gmontecristo.com
      secretName: gmontecristo-secret
  rules:
    - host: portal-dev.gmontecristo.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: #{servicesname}#
                port:
                  number: 80

---
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-hpa
  namespace: #{namespace}#
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: #{servicesname}#
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 3
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 70
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: memory
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 80
  behavior:
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 60
      selectPolicy: Max
      policies:
        - type: Percent
          value: 100
          periodSeconds: 60
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
      selectPolicy: Max
      policies:
        - type: Percent
          value: 50
          periodSeconds: 60

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#
  namespace: #{namespace}#
  labels:
    app: #{servicesname}#
    version: "#{tag}#"
spec:
  replicas: 2
  revisionHistoryLimit: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 0
      maxSurge: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: #{servicesname}#
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: #{servicesname}#
        version: "#{tag}#"
    spec:
      # Ajustado para 004: mover carga de app al user pool (más capacidad).
      nodeSelector:
        agentpool: userpool01
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      # Ajustado para 004: IP interna del ingress-nginx en el cluster 004.
      hostAliases:
        - ip: "10.6.2.240"
          hostnames:
            - "gateway-buklo.grupomontecristo.com"
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: false
        runAsUser: 0
        runAsGroup: 0
        fsGroup: 0
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
        - name: nginx-cache
          emptyDir:
            sizeLimit: 100Mi
        - name: app-logs
          emptyDir:
            sizeLimit: 50Mi
      containers:
        - name: #{servicesname}#
          image: "#{containerregistries}#/#{servicesname}##{ambiente}#:#{tag}#"
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
              protocol: TCP
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: #{servicesname}#-config
            - secretRef:
                name: #{servicesname}#-secret
          env:
            - name: TZ
              value: "America/Costa_Rica"
            - name: NODE_ENV
              value: "production"
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
            - name: nginx-cache
              mountPath: /var/cache/nginx
            - name: app-logs
              mountPath: /var/log/nginx
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "#{reqcpu}#m"
              memory: "#{reqmem}#Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "#{limcpu}#m"
              memory: "#{limmem}#Mi"
          # Health checks optimizados
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
              scheme: HTTP
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 30
            timeoutSeconds: 3
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
            timeoutSeconds: 2
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 30
            failureThreshold: 3
            timeoutSeconds: 5
          lifecycle:
            preStop:
              exec:
                command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 15"]
